notes.title: Demo 1.4.1 Update: Fresh Looks, Skill Revamp, and Better Editor!
notes.content: [p]This is likely the [b]last major update before our full release[/b]—and it’s packed with exciting changes![/p][p]✨ [b]New Look[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand-new [b]Cubs eye style[/b] for a fresh and expressive vibe.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tree art with full collision interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Air walls fade smoother and further, plus toned-down flashy effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚡ [b]Skill Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple skills reworked with new effects and sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved balance and smoother in-game performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Switch skills directly inside rooms for faster setup.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Better Rooms & Editor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cleaner lobby interface, invite friends without issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Map Editor upgraded with an object height slider and more intuitive drag & drop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new toggle between continuous and single object placement. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👀 [b]Observer & Gameplay Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing visual/camera effects in observer mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wall-climbing, start/finish formations, and clearer displacement indicators.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🔊 [b]Audio Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed low volume and synced spectator sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]New skill sound effects for more impact![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Jump back in, try the refreshed skills, and check out your Cubs’ new eyes—you’ll feel the difference. [/p]

tags.feature: Brand-new [b]Cubs eye style[/b] for a fresh and expressive vibe.
Updated tree art with full collision interaction.
Air walls fade smoother and further, plus toned-down flashy effects.
Multiple skills reworked with new effects and sounds.
Switch skills directly inside rooms for faster setup.
Cleaner lobby interface, invite friends without issues.
Map Editor upgraded with an object height slider and more intuitive drag & drop.
Added a new toggle between continuous and single object placement.

notes.title: Taipei Game Show here we come!
notes.content:
[h1]Arcade Galaxy Is Heading to the 2025 Taipei Game Show![/h1]
[h2]Booth Location: Indie House S-38[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/7d6c808ed2d58d6a8c1892acb5ae2dc6eb36b58c.png[/img]
Hello everyone! We are thrilled to announce that Arcade Galaxy will be part of the 2025 Taipei Game Show from January 23rd to 26th. This marks our second appearance at one of Taiwan’s largest gaming events! We’ve also prepared an exciting on-site giveaway event—don’t miss it!

[h2]🎮 Arcade Galaxy x Backbone Giveaway![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/bd5c388393bc5fdec81c82c496d6e387c154b2c6.png[/img]

This year, we’ve teamed up with Backbone to bring you amazing prizes. Participate at our booth for a chance to win:
[h3]🏆 Grand Prize: Backbone ULTRABACK Ergonomic Lumbar Cushion (NT$2,280 value)
🥈 Second Prize: Razer ORNATA V3 X Silent Membrane Gaming Keyboard (NT$1,249 value)
🥉 Third Prize: Logitech G304 Wireless Gaming Mouse (NT$888 value)
🎁 Special Prize: 10 Steam keys for Arcade Galaxy upon its release![/h3]

[h2]How to Participate:[/h2]
1️⃣ Play Arcade Galaxy at our booth.
2️⃣ Scan the QR code to add the game to your Steam wishlist and follow Backbone’s official page.
3️⃣ Leave your email to complete your entry.

Winners will be announced after the event ends. Steam keys will be sent immediately, while physical prizes will be shipped after February 4th.

[h2]What’s New in Arcade Galaxy:[/h2]
Get hands-on with the latest updates at the Taipei Game Show:

[h3]	•	Camera Rotation: Freely adjust your perspective to navigate with ease![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/c30a50661249f79ed4cbc50334a1e666f043dfa6.png[/img]

[h3]	•	Enhanced Connectivity: Significantly reduced disconnection risks and game crashes.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/1b9c23f80d7a1c0191e7d36abaa3b027d90231ab.png[/img]

[h3]	•	UI Optimization: A polished design and smoother user experience!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/2168f534534bb57ab6665afcf1479cc03430da9b.png[/img]

[h3]	•	Spectator Mode: Once you finish the race, switch to view other players still on the track!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/e436eeee0b7cafa4c895496ce1623c1edfc3ad22.png[/img]

We can’t wait to see you at the Taipei Game Show—visit us, participate in the giveaway, and dive into the fun of Arcade Galaxy! 🚀

notes.title: Unleash Your Creativity in a New Universe!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The moment we've all been waiting for is here - Arcade Galaxy's Closed Beta is now live! After more than two years of development, we're excited to invite you to be among the first to dive into this world of endless possibilities and imagination.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/755606e184361d315e031e2fc8fd41b711802e4c.png[/img]

[h1][b]🎮 What's Exciting in Arcade Galaxy?[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Create and customize your own unique worlds
[*] Engage in fun, action-packed adventures
[*] Play with friends in multiplayer modes
[/list]

[h1][b]🚀 Why Join the Beta?[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Help shape the game with your creative ideas and feedback
[*] Experience exclusive content before anyone else
[*] Be part of a community of passionate creators and gamers
[*] Influence the development of new features and game modes
[/list]

[h1][b]🎁 Beta Tester Rewards[/b][/h1]
As a thank you for your participation, beta testers will receive:
[list]
[*] Exclusive in-game items, Horror Hockey! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/1a0f771c5189b5bc6b67f342cff90a8d6c51b22c.png[/img]
[*] Gold Coin and Gems rewards! As the wishlist grows, all the participants would enjoy more rewards! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/b87a6344d8f9bc6d7bc934105e74ef277b500831.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1][list][*] [b]🎨 How to Join:[/b][/list][/h1]
[list]
[*] Wishlist Arcade Galaxy on Steam
[*] Click the "Request Access" button on our Steam page
[*] Enjoy the fun! 
[/list]

We can't wait to see the amazing creations and adventures you'll come up with in Arcade Galaxy. Let's make something awesome together!
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/YaDJjebg]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and ideas with fellow testers and developers! 
Get ready to play, create, and explore!

The Arcade Galaxy Team
